title: safercode
description: Your AI agent learns what to watch for in your kind of app, and has to flag every security decision to you before it makes the change. Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C and C++. Claude Code, Codex and Copilot are refused a change that wasn't flagged; each decision is recorded where it happened.

title: strictercode
description: Make your AI agent prove every function it writes, with tests that would catch a real bug, kept in your repo. Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C and C++. Claude Code isn't allowed to finish until they pass, or to delete them.
